description: Platform feature infrastructure + shell + guards + step-up primitives + shared-test extensions. Creates the features/platform module (keys, types, permissions, schemas, errors, stepUp, guard, hooks), the dedicated PlatformShell, the fail-closed PlatformGuard, the MfaEnrollmentGate, and the parameterized PlatformStepUpDialog; rewires app/platform/layout.tsx to use guard+gate+shell; and adds unit tests for every pure helper plus extensions to landing.test.ts and pageAccess.test.ts. Everything FEAT-002's screens import lands here. Leaves the codebase buildable (layout renders an empty shell until screens arrive; the existing all-in-one app/platform/page.tsx keeps compiling and is replaced in FEAT-002). Read .agents/tasks/frontend-platform-superadmin/context.json and this file FIRST.
steps: Create apps/web/src/features/platform/keys.ts — `platformKeys` factory per design C.6: stats()=['platform','stats']; institutions()=['platform','institutions']; modules(id)=['platform','institutions',id,'modules']; grants(institutionId?,status?)=['platform','support-grants',{institutionId:institutionId??null,status:status??null}]; grantOverview(grantId)=['platform','support-grants',grantId,'overview']; audit(scope,grantId,limit)=['platform','audit-events',{scope,grantId,limit}]. All `as const`.

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/types.ts — response/row types mirroring api-contract §3: PlatformStats{institutions{total,active,suspended},users{total,students},movement{totalPasses,currentlyOutside}}; InstitutionRow{id,name,code,domain|null,status:'ACTIVE'|'SUSPENDED',_count{users,departments,gates,exitReasons}}; CreateInstitutionResult{institution:InstitutionRow,admin{id,email,role},tempPassword:string}; ModuleMatrixRow{moduleKey,name,state,entitledAt,activatedAt,suspendedAt}; ModuleMatrixResponse{institutionId,modules:ModuleMatrixRow[]}; SupportGrant row (id,institutionId,grantedToUserId,purpose,status,expiresAt,activatedAt,revokedAt?,revokedReason?,createdAt); BreakGlassOverview{institutionId,auditEvents:AuditEvent[],passes:unknown[]}; AuditEvent + AuditEventsResponse{events:AuditEvent[]}.

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/permissions.ts — `export const PLATFORM_PERM = {...} as const satisfies Record<string, PermissionKey>` mapping the 7 platform.* keys (institutionsManage, analyticsView, onboarding, entitlementsManage, subscriptionsManage, supportGrant, securityRespond). Pattern: apps/web/src/features/exams/permissions.ts.

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/schemas.ts — zod with parity-pinned messages (design C.6.2/C.6.4/C.8): createInstitutionSchema {name: trim.min(1,'name, code and adminEmail are required'); code: same; adminEmail: trim.min(1,'name, code and adminEmail are required').email('adminEmail must be a valid email'); domain: trim.optional()}; createSupportGrantSchema {institutionId: min(1,'institutionId is required'); purpose: min(1,'purpose is required').max(500,'purpose must be at most 500 characters'); expiresAt: string refined strictly future AND <= now+4h with message 'expiresAt must be in the future and within 4 hours'; scope optional with .max(50) arrays}; and `clampAuditLimit(n:number):number` clamping to [1,100] default 50.

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/errors.ts — pure classifiers: isMfaEnrollmentRequired(err)= err instanceof ApiError && err.status===403 && err.data?.error==='MFA enrollment required' (EXACT string); isStepUpRequired(err)= err instanceof ApiError && err.status===401 && err.data?.error==='Step-up required'.

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/stepUp.ts — `export class PlatformStepUpError extends Error` (name 'PlatformStepUpError'); `export async function postWithStepUp<T>(endpoint, body, stepUpToken?)`: raw fetch mirroring features/exams/hooks.ts publishRequest — set Authorization from useAuthStore token + Content-Type, set x-step-up ONLY when stepUpToken passed; parse json; on !ok: if 401 && data.error==='Step-up required' throw PlatformStepUpError; else if 401 useAuthStore.getState().logout() then throw ApiError; else throw ApiError. Never log/store the token.

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/guard.ts — pure `decidePlatformAccess({hydrated,hasSession,isSuper}): 'skeleton'|'redirect'|'noaccess'|'allow'` — !hydrated->'skeleton'; !hasSession->'redirect'; !isSuper->'noaccess'; else 'allow' (fail-closed: absence never yields allow).

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/hooks.ts — typed hooks per endpoint using keys from step 1 (pattern features/exams/hooks.ts): useStats, useInstitutions, useCreateInstitution (mutation; onSuccess invalidate platformKeys.institutions(); DO NOT write the 201 result into any cache), useSetInstitutionStatus (PUT /institutions/:id/status {status}), useModuleMatrix(id), useGrantModule(id)/useRevokeModule(id) (DELETE .../:moduleKey), useSupportGrants(institutionId?,status?) (GET with query), useCreateSupportGrant (mutationFn uses postWithStepUp('/api/platform/support-grants', body, stepUpToken?)), useRevokeSupportGrant(id), useBreakGlassOverview(grantId, enabled) (shared api.get, enabled-gated), useAuditEvents(scope,grantId,limit,enabled) (shared api.get). All reads use shared api.* (403 never logs out); ONLY create-grant uses postWithStepUp.

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/guard component apps/web/src/components/platform/PlatformGuard.tsx — read hydrated/token/user/roles from useAuthStore; isSuper=roles.includes('SUPER_ADMIN') (SINGLE identity source — do NOT branch on user.role); useEffect redirects router.replace('/login') ONLY when hydrated && (!token||!user); render via decidePlatformAccess: 'skeleton'->FullPageSkeleton, 'redirect'->null, 'noaccess'-><NoAccess what="the platform console"/>, 'allow'->children. This REPLACES the old layout wrong-role /login behavior.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/MfaEnrollmentGate.tsx — React context providing reportError(err:unknown); when isMfaEnrollmentRequired(err) flips an internal flag; when flag set render an enrollment CTA + the existing <MfaEnrollment/> (import from @/components/MfaEnrollment); onEnrolled clears the flag and calls queryClient.invalidateQueries({queryKey:['platform']}); children otherwise. Export a useMfaGate() hook so screen queries can call reportError in their onError/useEffect.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/PlatformShell.tsx — light header 'CAMPUSGATE Platform / Super Admin', side nav links (Dashboard /platform, Institutions /platform/institutions, Support grants /platform/support-grants, Audit /platform/audit), an Enable-MFA entry, and a Sign out button (logout()+router.replace('/login')). NOT AppShell; no module probes; no tenant nav.

Create apps/web/src/components/platform/PlatformStepUpDialog.tsx — generalized copy of components/exams/StepUpDialog.tsx taking props {open,onOpenChange,action:string,onToken:(token:string)=>void}; use existing useStepUp() with {code, action}; handle /verify 400s ('Invalid code'->inline field error, 'MFA not enrolled'->inline notice); call onToken(token) and never store it. Leave components/exams/StepUpDialog.tsx UNTOUCHED.

Modify apps/web/src/app/platform/layout.tsx — remove the current useEffect that router.replace('/login') on user.role!=='SUPER_ADMIN'; wrap children as <PlatformGuard><MfaEnrollmentGate><PlatformShell>{children}</PlatformShell></MfaEnrollmentGate></PlatformGuard>. Keep it a client component.

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/__tests__/keys.test.ts — assert every parameterized key includes all params (modules id; grants institutionId+status; grantOverview grantId; audit scope+grantId+limit) — acceptance 14.

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/__tests__/schemas.test.ts — required-field strings match the server exactly, email message, purpose 1..500 bounds, expiresAt future/<=4h accept+reject cases, clampAuditLimit clamps to [1,100] and defaults.

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/__tests__/guard.test.ts — decidePlatformAccess exhaustive table over {hydrated,hasSession,isSuper} proving fail-closed (no branch yields 'allow' without hydrated+hasSession+isSuper).

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/__tests__/errors.test.ts — isMfaEnrollmentRequired true only for 403 + exact 'MFA enrollment required'; false for other status/strings/non-ApiError; isStepUpRequired true only for 401 + 'Step-up required'.

Create apps/web/src/features/platform/__tests__/stepUp.test.ts — mock global fetch: 201 ok asserts x-step-up header present when token passed and absent otherwise, and that action string wiring is 'support_grant.create' at the caller; 401 {error:'Step-up required'} -> rejects with PlatformStepUpError (no logout); 401 {error:'Unauthorized'} -> logout called + ApiError.

Modify apps/web/src/lib/__tests__/landing.test.ts — KEEP the existing landingRoute(['SUPER_ADMIN'],[]) -> '/platform' assertion; ADD a case proving a normal tenant user (e.g. landingRoute(['STUDENT'], [...ROLE_PERMISSIONS.STUDENT])) never resolves to '/platform' (it is '/student'). Do NOT modify lib/landing.ts.

Modify apps/web/src/features/__tests__/pageAccess.test.ts — add 6 platform PageAccessRow entries mapping each route to its platform.* guard key (/platform->platform.analytics.view, /platform/institutions->platform.institutions.manage, /platform/institutions/[id]/modules->platform.entitlements.manage, /platform/support-grants->platform.support.grant, /platform/support-grants/[id]/overview->platform.support.grant, /platform/audit->platform.security.respond) with role 'SUPER_ADMIN'; the existing assertions then verify ROLE_PERMISSIONS.SUPER_ADMIN holds each key.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` in apps/web passes with the new features/platform module and components present (no type errors).
`npx vitest run src/features/platform` passes all new unit tests (keys, schemas, guard, errors, stepUp).
`npm test` in apps/web passes the full suite including the extended landing.test.ts and pageAccess.test.ts (>= 516 prior tests still green, plus the new ones).
`npm run build` compiles with the rewritten app/platform/layout.tsx (guard+gate+shell) and the unchanged existing app/platform/page.tsx.
lib/landing.ts is unchanged; components/exams/StepUpDialog.tsx is unchanged; no new dependency added to apps/web/package.json.
verification: cd c:/campusgate/apps/web && npx vitest run src/features/platform src/lib/__tests__/landing.test.ts src/features/__tests__/pageAccess.test.ts
findings:
DONE. Verification all green in apps/web: `npm run lint` (tsc) exit 0; targeted `npx vitest run src/features/platform src/lib/__tests__/landing.test.ts src/features/__tests__/pageAccess.test.ts` = 7 files / 110 tests pass; full `npm test` = 64 files / 562 tests pass (baseline was 59/516, +46 new); `npm run build` compiles with /platform.

NEW EXPORTED SYMBOLS FEAT-002 can import:
- features/platform/keys.ts: `platformKeys` {stats, institutions, modules(id), grants(institutionId?,status?), grantOverview(grantId), audit(scope,grantId,limit)}; `type AuditScope = 'platform'|'grant'`.
- features/platform/types.ts: InstitutionStatus, PlatformStats, InstitutionRow, CreateInstitutionResult, ModuleState, ModuleMatrixRow, ModuleMatrixResponse, SupportGrantStatus, SupportGrant, AuditEvent, AuditEventsResponse, BreakGlassOverview.
- features/platform/permissions.ts: `PLATFORM_PERM` (institutionsManage, analyticsView, onboarding, entitlementsManage, subscriptionsManage, supportGrant, securityRespond) as const satisfies Record<string,PermissionKey>.
- features/platform/schemas.ts: createInstitutionSchema (+CreateInstitutionValues), createSupportGrantSchema (+CreateSupportGrantValues), clampAuditLimit(n).
- features/platform/errors.ts: isMfaEnrollmentRequired(err), isStepUpRequired(err) — exact-string classifiers.
- features/platform/stepUp.ts: class PlatformStepUpError; postWithStepUp<T>(endpoint, body, stepUpToken?).
- features/platform/guard.ts: type PlatformAccess; decidePlatformAccess({hydrated,hasSession,isSuper}).
- features/platform/hooks.ts: useStats, useInstitutions, useModuleMatrix(id), useSupportGrants(institutionId?,status?), useBreakGlassOverview(grantId,enabled), useAuditEvents(scope,grantId,limit,enabled), useCreateInstitution (+CreateInstitutionBody), useSetInstitutionStatus(id), useGrantModule(id), useRevokeModule(id), useCreateSupportGrant (+CreateSupportGrantBody; takes {body, stepUpToken?}), useRevokeSupportGrant(id).
- components/platform/PlatformGuard.tsx {children}; MfaEnrollmentGate.tsx {children} + useMfaGate() -> {reportError(err)}; PlatformShell.tsx {children}; PlatformStepUpDialog.tsx {open,onOpenChange,action,onToken}.

DECISIONS / DEVIATIONS:
- Break-glass overview endpoint path is `/api/platform/support-grants/:id/tenant/overview` (per api-contract §3.5), not `/overview`; useBreakGlassOverview targets that path.
- useRevokeSupportGrant uses shared api.delete (no body); the contract's optional {reason?} is not sent because api.delete carries no body. If FEAT-002 needs to send a revoke reason, switch it to a raw fetch/postWith* variant.
- api.ts already exported API_BASE; postWithStepUp imports it rather than redeclaring NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.
- useCreateInstitution DOES NOT write the 201 (tempPassword) into any cache; it only invalidates the institutions list. useCreateSupportGrant/postWithStepUp never log or store the step-up token. Secret hygiene honored.
- layout.tsx is now <PlatformGuard><MfaEnrollmentGate><PlatformShell>{children}</...>; old wrong-role router.replace('/login') removed — wrong role now renders <NoAccess what='the platform console'/>. Existing app/platform/page.tsx (all-in-one scaffold) is UNCHANGED and still compiles; it is to be replaced in FEAT-002.
- components/exams/StepUpDialog.tsx and lib/landing.ts left untouched; no new dependency added to package.json.
